title: Sign in to the storefront
description: Registered shoppers sign in with a username and password to reach the product catalogue. Locked accounts must not get in.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given a valid standard account, when the shopper signs in, then the product list titled "Products" is shown.
Given a locked-out account, when the shopper signs in, then the error "Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out." is shown and the shopper stays on the login page.
Given a wrong password, when the shopper signs in, then the error "Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service" is shown.

source: examples/requirements (synthetic example for the saucedemo.com demo target)
